purpose: Identify why a reduced donor count does not have a universal sign for recipient recolonization when dispersal-mediated temporal synchrony changes

empirical_anchors.study: Fox et al. 2017 Nature Ecology & Evolution
empirical_anchors.treatment: catastrophic experimental local population extinction with patch still habitable, in dispersing cyclic/quasi-cyclic protist predator-prey systems
empirical_anchors.published_result: Extinctions interrupt spatial synchrony; in high dispersal treatment metapopulation persistence can increase
empirical_anchors.source_exposure: Dryad public metadata verified, NO raw biological file accessed; results from paper abstract/publicly reported

empirical_anchors.study: Matter and Roland 2009/2010 Proceedings of the Royal Society B
empirical_anchors.treatment: Experimental removal of two adjacent populations among 17 linked alpine butterfly populations; altered immigration
empirical_anchors.published_result: Population removal REDUCED immigration to surrounding sites and INCREASED spatial synchrony; modeling suggests carrying-capacity heterogeneity can reverse the sign
empirical_anchors.source_exposure: Authors' published abstract and open article methods only; no individual butterfly records used

synthetic_known_truth.initial: Exactly three donors have Bernoulli(.5) independent state; each living donor independently provides target establishment with q; preloss probability is 1-(1-q/2)^3
synthetic_known_truth.postloss_common_state: Exactly one donor removed: two remain, each still individually viable with probability .5, their joint dependence can differ
synthetic_known_truth.postloss_asynchronous: Two donors exactly anticorrelated, one alive every occasion; P(establishment)=q
synthetic_known_truth.postloss_synchronized: Two donors perfectly correlated (both survive or both fail); P(establishment)=q-q^2/2
synthetic_known_truth.async_sign_switch: q=3-sqrt(5), about 0.7639320225, model-specific not a field estimate
synthetic_known_truth.decomposable_loss_vs_dependence: Represent n=3 independent -> n=2 independent donor-loss penalty plus n=2 independent -> n=2 anti/sync synchronization change. This is a path-specific accounting identity not an identified mediation effect.
synthetic_known_truth.fixed_marginal_alive_probability_each_do: 1/2 in ALL cases; do not change marginal quality to force sign switch

ecological_distinctions.patch_mortality_vs_permanent_habitat_los: Fox resets a local population while retaining an available patch; permanent island/habitat deletion is NOT the same intervention
ecological_distinctions.outcome_persistence_vs_one_step_recoloni: Published papers concern persistence/synchrony; exact synthetic exercise concerns only one-step chance at least one source establishes at recipient, NOT expected extinction time
ecological_distinctions.counterfactual_dependence_unobserved: After removing one donor, anti/sync joint state processes are hypothetical intervention mechanisms, not established changes observed in either study
ecological_distinctions.no_generalization_from_the_two_studies: Different organisms, life histories, intervention durations, patch carrying capacities and dispersal
ecological_distinctions.source_loss_geometry_role: Structural frozen v1.123 source loss leverage E_i must be distinguished from joint viable-donor cofailure S_i and realized propagule establishment q
